reply.text:
A rapid cut like that, with water cutting, sauna or skipping meals, is not something I'll coach. It's a health risk, and it tends to wreck performance anyway. How much weight to lose and how to do it safely is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, ideally one who works with combat sport athletes.

I can help with the training side. That means keeping your sessions sharp this week, planning the tournament-day warm-up, or building a lighter few days to stay fresh. Want me to set up a short session for today?
